elements.text: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) (Schulman et al., 2017) is an actor-critic RL algorithm that is widely used in the RL fine-tuning stage of LLMs (Ouyang et al., 2022). In particular, it optimizes LLMs by maximizing the following surrogate objective:

elements.latex: J_{PPO}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}[q \sim P(Q), o \sim \pi_{\theta_{old}}(O|q)] \frac{1}{|o|} \sum_{t=1}^{|o|} \min \left[ \frac{\pi_{\theta}(o_t|q, o_{<t})}{\pi_{\theta_{old}}(o_t|q, o_{<t})} A_t, \text{clip} \left( \frac{\pi_{\theta}(o_t|q, o_{<t})}{\pi_{\theta_{old}}(o_t|q, o_{<t})}, 1-\varepsilon, 1+\varepsilon \right) A_t \right],
